Welcome to Memora

One private memory that you and your AI apps share, so nothing has to be explained twice.

  • Your notes, your files Plain Markdown in a folder you choose
  • Brain, Graph, Canvas See how your notes connect
  • One memory for every AI Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and more, each with its own key
  • From anywhere This computer, your network or the internet
